corrective01_architecture.domains: 16 fixed v2 domains platform:v2:00..0f plus preserved v1 legacy domain; independent head locks and domain-bound facts/digests; finite domain/fact CHECK prevents unenumerated rows.
corrective01_architecture.derivation: First SHA-256 byte of registered producer + colon + canonical trusted target UUID modulo16; server derived, no append-domain request selector.
corrective01_architecture.claims: Source FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; fresh receipt recheck; domain-head NOWAIT in bounded batch. Claim, ledger, head and receipt commit together; busy-head rollback excludes source for current invocation. No leases; no unlimited queue fairness claim.
corrective01_architecture.producer_authority: Immutable source-code registry binds subsystem, DB role, actions/targets, human/service actors, metadata schema and durability. Sentinel sole production entry; synthetic extension is test-only. DB stamps session_user and worker rejects role/producer mismatch.
corrective01_architecture.privileges: Worker UPDATE(id) on intents is row-lock enabling only; immutable trigger still forbids actual changes. Runtime receives no generic platform journal/ledger write permission.
corrective01_architecture.verification: Explicit validated domains; single repeatable-read multi-domain snapshot; bounded requested-domain completion distinct from all17-domain inclusion; no global sequence order.

coverage.scope: Combined canonical statement/branch coverage; no focused-package substitution.
